description: This script sets up and runs a performance test for Git repository operations, specifically focusing on tag-following performance with many tags. It creates a fake repository hierarchy, populates it with large numbers of commits and tags, and measures fetch performance.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a series of commits with unique files pointing to a specific blob, simulating a long history.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates a series of tags for the commits in the specified revision range.
